exact: GDP-L-fucose biosynthetic process, de novo pathway

definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of GDP-L-fucose from GDP-D-mannose via GDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-mannose, requiring the functions of GDP-mannose 4,6-dehydratase (EC:4.2.1.47) and GDP-L-fucose synthase (EC:1.1.1.271).
label: 'de novo' GDP-L-fucose biosynthetic process
